def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """
    import numpy as np
    remainder = bins % item
    min_dist = np.minimum(remainder, item - remainder)
    return np.where(bins >= item, -min_dist, -np.inf)

def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:

    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """
    import numpy as np
    mask = bins >= item
    leftover_space = bins - item

    return np.where(mask, -discrepancy, -np.inf)

def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """
    import numpy as np
    target_ratio = 0.6  # predefined target fraction of bin capacity the item should occupy
    mask = bins >= item
    ratio = item / bins
    diff = np.abs(ratio - target_ratio)
    return np.where(mask, -diff, -np.inf)
